collection.title: Tesla Model X 2013 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Tesla Model X 2013 Onwards is fitted with a new type of wiper blade called the 'AquaBlade'. This unique type of wiper, developed by Valeo, delivers wiper fluid directly onto the windscreen through the wiper blade. The drivers side requires a 28” and an 18” for the passenger's side.
